newsitem.title: CHINA: Remarriage returns speech to griefstricken groom.
newsitem.headline: Remarriage returns speech to griefstricken groom.

text.p: A Chinese bridegroom, who lost the power of speech 21 years ago when his first wife divorced him, found his voice when he wed a new bride, the Beijing Evening News said on Friday.
Shi Nengshou, 45, a farmer in eastern Zhejiang province had a few drinks, burst into tears and started to speak in broken sentences at his recent wedding banquet, the newspaper said.
Shi's first wife divorced him in 1976 and he never spoke again, spending most of his time in his fields, it said.
